ruleblock.statementbody: A standard loan runs for fourteen days from the day of issue.
A short loan runs for two days and may not be renewed.

gridholder.gridcaption: Table 1. Loan period by item class

bullets.point: no fine in the first two days

ruleblock.statementbody: The fine is the number of days overdue multiplied by the daily rate for the item class.
The fine for one item is capped at eight units.
No fine is charged where the overdue period is two days or fewer for a standard loan.
ruleblock.sidenote: Librarians may waive a fine; a waiver is recorded but does not change the calculation.

ruleblock.statementbody: A standard loan may be renewed twice, each renewal running for a further fourteen days.
A loan with a reservation against it may not be renewed.
